definitions: A hypothetical lost continent in the Indian Ocean, proposed in the 19th century to explain the distribution of lemurs and other species.
A fictional continent or landmass often featured in fantasy and science fiction literature.
examples: The theory of Lemuria was largely discredited by plate tectonics.
Many ancient myths speak of a sunken land, reminiscent of Lemuria.
Explorers sought the lost city of Lemuria.
